title: Zoom - Scheduled Zoom Software Quarterly Lifecycle Update (11/7/2026)
text:
Service: Zoom
Maintenance: Scheduled Zoom Software Quarterly Lifecycle Update (11/7/2026)
Status: scheduled
Impact: maintenance

Updates:
- 2026-10-07T17:15:29.408-07:00: scheduled - As a reminder approximately 30 days ahead of the upcoming enforcement, Zoom will be enforcing a new global minimum version this November 7. This affects the following products:

 ◦ VDI plugin
